name: Sulcavis
sum: Bohaiornithid from Liaoning, the first bird known with grooved tooth enamel.
holotype: BMNH Ph-000805, from near Lamadong, Liaoning.
biology: Robust teeth with grooves on the inner surface, probably strengthening them against hard food.
author: O'Connor et al. 2013
